column2: The 256-byte basic parameter pack BODY, field by field.
byte-for-byte against card-dumps/primary-region.bin at flash 0x70000 and against
IMPORTANT OFFSET CONVENTION: "body" offsets below are offsets into the 256-byte
body. On the wire and in docs/record-0x01-fields.md the "pack" offset = body + 4
(the 4-byte pack header [0x05,0x00,0x00,sub]). In the boot image at flash 0x70000
the body starts at image offset 0x0000, i.e. image offset == body offset.
rec = byte offset into the 764-byte record 0x01 payload.
endian: BE = big-endian on the wire even though the record stores LE.
Bytes not listed are never written by GetBasicParam and stay zero.

column5: line_dir>=2: [module width, module height/2]; line_dir<2: [module height/2, module width]
modules chained along the data-line direction (GetModuleCountInLineDir)
CardScanLen = OneScanLen * modulesInLineDir (256 for one module; 512 factory)
head code: rec+0x008 low nibble mapped {0->2,1->3,2->0,3->1,else 0}, OR module-dim high bits into bits 4-5 and 6-7
constant 0x80 written by the image writer
driver-chip id if < 0x100, else the escape literal 0xFE
modules in line dir per split segment
[rec+0x043, rec+0x044 | (rec+0x04E & 1)] = data-group/output code with the 32-group flag
current gains R, G, B, virtual-R (0-63 each)
screen extent along the data-line direction (GetMaxInLineDir)
GetModuleInputCount = max(1, 16 / module dim along line dir)
luminance level split by current percents, emitted as R, B, rest, G (u16 BE each)
chip-custom block; +0x70 bit7 = use self GCK, bits0-6 + next byte = chip reset serial clock
special-module setting, written only when rec+0x01A bit6 is set, else 0
SChipControl block (chip-library constant; carries the GCLK-count fields)
three u16 fields (0x4000 each in our config)
full 16-bit driver-chip id; zero when the id fitted the byte slot at 0x1B
CRC-32 (poly 0xEDB88320, init/final 0xFFFFFFFF) over body[0x00..0xFC] with body[0x1B], [0xE7], [0xE8] forced to zero
